title: Consolidation: Irony & Humour
goal: Combine *¡Ni que...!*, understatement, sarcastic reactions, *como si* and satirical rhetoric

items: I can use *¡Ni que* + imperfect or pluperfect subjunctive! to reject absurd assumptions ironically.
I can combine understatement, overstatement and sarcastic exclamations naturally in speech.
I can use *como si* + pluperfect subjunctive and rhetorical devices in deadpan humour and satire.
